newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 739,000 barrels in the week ended October 30 to 11.373 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks also rose by a massive 1.963 million barrels to an at least 34-month record of 9.790 million barrels. Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks fell by 414,000 barrels to 5.678 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
